selection_discipline: All100 native outcomes reviewed after immutable preregistration; no replacements. Benchmark selection is intentionally post-review and does not alter the registered100. Earlier public SWARM evidence informed the preregistered strata; this is not a blinded sample.

cases.selection_reason: Simple complete FRAME baseline; first member of matched seed605 profile triplet.
cases.review_note: Sparse rectilinear frame is readable and all 50 mandatory connectors are fulfilled; strongest simple authoring baseline.

cases.selection_reason: Branching FRAME profile and unresolved mandatory connector; match C001/C003.
cases.review_note: Branching changes the free-space skeleton visibly; one mandatory connector remains unresolved despite a single material component.

cases.selection_reason: Dense FRAME profile; distinguish extra cohesion and braces from mandatory completion.
cases.review_note: Denser braces and cohesion enrich the frame; one unresolved mandatory connector remains and density is not a support certificate.

cases.selection_reason: Damage derivative of C002; verify receipt revocation and retained failure.
cases.review_note: Damaged derivative breaks the intact C002 frame into 17 components and revokes connector receipts; 70 mandatory connectors are unresolved.

cases.selection_reason: Successful categorical MOSAIC motifs; match C023 with same seed and fixture.
cases.review_note: Branching-profile MOSAIC changes categorical motifs into a varied repeated facade; complete, with two components as a descriptive fact.

cases.selection_reason: Dense MOSAIC structure and profile-bundle comparison.
cases.review_note: Dense MOSAIC increases occupied material and changes motifs; visually richer but still a strongly repeated grid.

cases.selection_reason: Concave sparse MOSAIC UNSAT retained as a first-class negative.
cases.review_note: Sparse concave MOSAIC is proven UNSAT; the retained blank material array is a valid negative outcome, not a missing screenshot.

cases.selection_reason: Affinity-zero RECEPTOR control; pair with C043, not a winner-only selection.
cases.review_note: Affinity-zero foreign-solid RECEPTOR control: 566 generated cells and ten components.

cases.selection_reason: Isolated visible environmental affinity effect with continued disconnected output.
cases.review_note: Affinity-one changes 168 material cells versus C042 and adds environmental wrapping; eleven components remain, so changed is not automatically better.

cases.selection_reason: Promising stepped FRAME-MOSAIC meeting; optional versus mandatory contention.
cases.review_note: Dense stepped meeting is visually promising; six new bridges plus one adjacent contact coexist with four unresolved required connectors. Compared all three controls.

cases.selection_reason: Concave FRAME-MOSAIC limitation with exact paths and unresolved requirements.
cases.review_note: Concave pairing adapts the contour and yields two joins, yet five required connectors remain unresolved. Compared all three controls.

cases.selection_reason: Protected-space correctness with partial seam resolution.
cases.review_note: Protected corridor pairing adds three bounded joins while keeping the corridor clear; two required connectors remain unresolved. Compared all three controls.

cases.selection_reason: Foreign-solid preservation; optional success coexists with required failure.
cases.review_note: Foreign-solid pairing produces two optional-only joins and leaves five required connectors unresolved; context preservation is correct but required success is incomplete.

cases.selection_reason: Island FRAME-MOSAIC meeting: own-territory outline adaptation and final local bridge benefit are separately visible.
cases.review_note: Island own-territory awareness improves the outline over independent clipping; the final two validated bridges improve local continuity while one required connector remains. Compared all three controls.

cases.selection_reason: Narrow-neck zero-join failure despite late additions; potential future presolve research discriminator.
cases.review_note: Narrow-neck pairing adds fourteen adapter cells and four cohesion cells but achieves zero joins; retain the visibly unresolved gap. Compared all three controls.

cases.selection_reason: Second seed on island; retain seed sensitivity and incomplete requirements.
cases.review_note: Second-seed island pairing makes four joins but leaves two required connectors unresolved; compare C059 rather than selecting only the preferred seed.

cases.selection_reason: Protected FRAME-RECEPTOR zero-contact negative.
cases.review_note: Protected FRAME-RECEPTOR case adds no seam geometry and achieves no joins; three required connectors remain unresolved. Compared all three controls.

cases.selection_reason: Ten validated bridges and all mandatory connectors fulfilled, but visually awkward and fragmented.
cases.review_note: Dense island FRAME-RECEPTOR has all 45 required connectors fulfilled and ten bridges, yet retains thirteen components and awkward thin links. Native blocked status predates final fulfillment. Compared all three controls.

cases.selection_reason: Ugly valid adjacent contacts with no new bridge cells and 382 adapter cells; clipped preference.
cases.review_note: Dense foreign-solid MOSAIC-RECEPTOR adds 382 adapter cells and registers four adjacent contacts with zero new bridge cells. The leaner clipped control is visually preferable for this authoring judgment. Compared all three controls.

cases.selection_reason: Bounded generator-work exhaustion; keep distinct from proven UNSAT.
cases.review_note: FRAME generator-work limit of one exhausts before useful output; satisfiability is not disproven.
